about_the_game:
You are a dangerous entity wielding the forbidden power of Indulge.

With this dark ability, you dive into the deepest recesses of a woman’s mind—unraveling fragments of her hidden psyche. As the puzzle forms, she slips into your grasp, unable to resist the pull, and surrenders to your will.

Armed with this seductive power, you set out to conquer mesmerizing women, one by one.

The gameplay unfolds as an addictive, tension-filled Tetris-style puzzle.
Clear lines to earn rewards, hit target scores, and unlock new stages.

The prize?
Provocative artwork and rich, tantalizing stories. With each level, the scenes grow bolder, unveiling the secret desires of these alluring characters.

Features:

  • A fatal tale of temptation woven through the Indulge ability

  • Thrilling Tetris-inspired puzzle mechanics with a dark twist

  • Mature illustrations and intense narratives revealed with each level

  • Unique, unforgettable characters with hidden charms and secrets

content_descriptors.notes: "This game contains sexual themes, nudity, and depictions of sexual acts. Some scenes may include sexual dialogue and visual representations of sexual activity. Additionally, the game may feature adult humor and sensitive topics."

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 710 / AMD Radeon HD 8570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB MB available space
